findings.title: HEAD-binding check is evaded by skip-worktree / assume-unchanged on a tracked input
findings.summary: _dirty_input_errors relies on `git status --porcelain`, which hides a modified tracked file whose index entry carries the skip-worktree or assume-unchanged bit, while _read_bytes still returns the modified working-tree bytes as the evidence.
findings.reproduction: raw2/r2_atk6.txt (V-a). Closed fixture: commit a widened FRZ row (Gate B FAIL, B-11), restore the correct row only in the working tree, `git update-index --skip-worktree` (or --assume-unchanged) on the checklist: `git status --porcelain` is empty and Gate A PASS + Gate B PASS with HEAD still widened. The same-size/old-mtime variant (V-b) is detected.
findings.impact: A PASS can still be produced for a state that is not the committed publication by anyone who can write the repository index (same access class as the replace-ref attack that RA-01 treats as in scope). Canonical cannot PASS today (B-4/P3 open).
findings.required_correction: Do not use git status as the oracle: compare every read input byte-wise with the HEAD blob (the existing _worktree_matches_blob contract) or check `git ls-files -v`/`git diff-index HEAD` with the skip/assume flags rejected.

findings.title: Uncommitted edits to verifier code that is not a read input are not flagged
findings.summary: The dirty check covers read inputs, the evidence root and the preflight script itself. Imported verifier code outside that set (scripts/governance/iiac_common.py, iiac_activation_gate.py, scripts/qualification/evol_x_frz_evol_canonical_matrix.py) can be modified in the working tree without any A-21/B-12.
findings.reproduction: raw2/real_chain_variants.txt (V-c1, V-c2): clone of ca78b1c1f, one comment line appended; `git status` shows M; canonical b6-readiness still reports exactly the two A-18 and no A-21. Control V-c3 (the preflight script) is flagged.
findings.impact: Local tampering with validators (validate_manifest_dict, _findings_errors, _path_rejected, canonical FRZ requirements) is not bound to HEAD; only hypothetical today because the blocker checks live in the protected script.
findings.required_correction: Include every imported repository module (or all of scripts/) in the dirty-state check.

findings.title: Free-text channels remain in values that are only type- or key-checked
findings.summary: Gate A still accepts: arbitrary text appended to an OPEN blocker entry (key-only comparison, e.g. B-5), extra free-text keys in resolved_blockers_for_closure entries, a token-shaped stage_closure_status of up to 64 characters carrying scope words, and a committed addendum file elsewhere under iiac_evidence/EVOL-X/ (outside the certification directory). An unindexed file in audit/ or certification/ is rejected.
findings.reproduction: raw2/r2_atk6.txt V-d, V-e, V-f, V-g (accepted) and V-g2 (rejected).
findings.impact: Nothing consumes these values; they are descriptive. Gate-consumed scope and the originally reported channels are sealed.
findings.required_correction: Compare open blocker texts with the baseline (or hash them), allow-list resolved-entry keys, use an enum for stage_closure_status, bind the evidence root file set.

findings.title: Further git-level redirections not tested
findings.summary: A forged commit-graph, a core.fsmonitor program reporting no changes (would defeat git status like W402-01), alternates, and commit ordering by committer date in the first-publication derivation (a side-branch commit with an old date could only cause a fail-closed rejection, not a pass) were not exercised.
findings.required_correction: Prefer content comparison over git metadata (see W402-01).
